evidence_text:
Comparison brief: Kestrelq Broker vs Almadine Broker
evidence_dose=-2 (positive ⇒ more points favour Kestrelq Broker)

- p1: sustained throughput (msg/s): Kestrelq Broker=285000  | Almadine Broker=410000 ← better
- p2: end-to-end p99 (ms): Kestrelq Broker=23  | Almadine Broker=14 ← better
- p3: broker memory per partition (MB): Kestrelq Broker=9.8  | Almadine Broker=6.2 ← better
- p4: cluster licence cost ($/mo): Kestrelq Broker=2450  | Almadine Broker=1800 ← better
- p5: rebalance duration (s): Kestrelq Broker=8 ← better | Almadine Broker=19
- p6: exactly-once overhead (%): Kestrelq Broker=14  | Almadine Broker=7 ← better
- p7: max retained topics: Kestrelq Broker=50000 ← better | Almadine Broker=32000
- p8: cold-start recovery (min): Kestrelq Broker=6.0  | Almadine Broker=2.5 ← better

Tally: Kestrelq Broker better on 2/8; Almadine Broker better on 6/8.
